notes: Access: PerimeterX-protected SFCC/Demandware site; standard fetches blocked, but curl_cffi with mobile impersonation (safari17_2_ios) reached all pages cleanly (matches prior Furniture/Home-Decor pass in notes/14.md). Site-wide category sitemap (sitemap_7-category.xml, 1993 URLs) is the definitive category tree; grepped it for pet/dog/crate/kennel/leash/collar/litter/scratch and found only 3 URLs, all under /c/pet/ - proving Pet is a small, isolated branch not surfaced in main nav (homepage SSR HTML has zero 'pet' mentions; it's reachable only via direct URL/sitemap). Checked all 3: (1) /c/pet/ (H1 'Pet') renders exactly 4 products, each with gtmdata category 'Pet/Pet Beds' (all are Crosley/Winslow 'Credenza Dog Crate' furniture-style pet crates); (2) /c/pet/beds/ (H1 'Pet Beds') renders the identical 4 products, identical '1 - 4 items' header - same underlying listing as the parent, so merged into one row (Pet Beds) per the same-listing merge rule rather than emitting a duplicate parent row; (3) /c/pet/bowls-and-feeders/ returned the site's 'Product Search Results No Hits' template (0 products) - dropped per the zero-product rule, noted here as checked. /c/pet/mats/, /c/pet/crosley/, /c/pet/brown/, /c/pet/white/ seen linked from the PLP are refinement-value URLs (color/brand facets), not distinct categories - /c/pet/mats/ canonicalizes to /c/pet/beds/ confirming this. No pet-food/consumable or medical/veterinary categories found anywhere on the site.
